facts.anchor: I was dying to tell Georgia that Zak and I had taken turns wanking in her shop’s bathroom, but I doubted she’d find it as titillating as I had.
facts.fact: Georgia 手术当天，Meg 在店里心不在焉地盘点库存——Georgia 的话应验：人们会「暂时淡忘」店。

facts.anchor: She was in such good spirits, though, she might just laugh herself right out of her wheelchair.
facts.fact: Zak 提早来盘货（shop assistant 的角色），两人并排数商品，她注意到他耳后有一颗痣。

facts.anchor: At least she was home with her sister again. It was Sunday. Gail and her family were out, but she’d encouraged me to come sit with Georgia so she wouldn’t worry.
facts.fact: 他们谈起各自最不愿承认的事：他说是「我父母当年一定希望我别回来」；她说是「我女儿有时看我的眼神像在看陌生人」。

facts.anchor: It was great to see Georgia smiling, even in pajamas and still a little dopey from pain meds.
facts.fact: 他透露母亲的第五次住院（阿尔茨海默的进程）与无法向母亲承认「我回来了」的愧疚。

facts.anchor: “It’s a different pain,” she told me. “I can tell it’s healing pain. I can live with that. What’s all this?” She peeked into the bag of samples I’d brought. “I have my trusty-reliable.”
facts.fact: 她的秘密：Roddie 出柜的事她曾「希望他自己解决」——她为这个念头羞耻。

facts.anchor: “I registered for an online trade show. I wanted the education workshops, but that was the swag bag they sent attendees. I thought you might want to test drive a few, or tell me which ones a
facts.fact: 他透露自己与 Georgia 的父亲一样：回家因为父亲需要，也因为不想承认自己也需要。

facts.anchor: “I’ll look through it later.” She set it aside. “Tell me what’s been going on.”
facts.fact: 他问她会不会有一天对 Roddie 说「我很为你骄傲」——她说她怕说得太轻。

facts.anchor: I told her about the long hunt for a replacement charger for an older toy and how excited one guy had been when he found out there was a product to replicate his penis for his girlfriend.
facts.fact: 他留她吃饭（她的生日礼物是「一顿饭」）；她在店里等到打烊，Georgia 的短信到了：「今晚一起吃饭。」
